abstract: We report a case of small intestinal type adenocarcinoma arising in retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma in a young male. The patient initially experienced intermittent abdominal pain, and radiographic workup revealed an encapsulated retroperitoneal mass. A laparotomy was performed and the resected specimen represented a cystic lesion, the inner surface of which was mostly covered by sebaceous debris with hairs. Microscopically, mature derivatives of all three germ layers as well as completely developed gastrointestinal tract were identified. Adenocarcinoma without stromal invasion was observed adjacent to the small intestinal mucosa. Immunohistochemistry of the adenocarcinoma tissue revealed p53 overexpression and high Ki-67 labeling index as well as positive staining for CD10, cytokeratin 7, and cytokeratin 20. Therefore, the diagnosis of small intestinal adenocarcinoma was made. To our knowledge, this is the first case of small intestinal adenocarcinoma arising in retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma. A unique feature of this case is that malignant transformation in retroperitoneal mature teratoma arose even in the fully developed intestine. Favorable prognosis due to detection in the 'early stage' is also discussed.
abstract_ja: 後腹膜の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に由来した小腸型腺癌の症例を報告する。若年男性が間欠的な腹痛を経験し、画像検査で被膜に覆われた後腹膜腫瘤が認められた。開腹術を施行し、切除検体は嚢胞性病変で、内面の大部分は皮脂様の残渣と毛髪で覆われていた。顕微鏡的に、三胚葉すべての成熟成分と、完全に発達した消化管が認められた。小腸粘膜に隣接して、間質浸潤のない腺癌が認められた。腺癌組織の免疫組織化学では、p53の過剰発現と高いKi-67標識率、およびCD10、サイトケラチン7、サイトケラチン20の陽性染色が認められた。以上より小腸腺癌と診断した。我々の知る限り、後腹膜の成熟奇形腫に生じた小腸腺癌の初めての症例である。本症例の特徴は、後腹膜成熟奇形腫における悪性転化が、完全に発達した腸管においても生じていた点である。「早期」での発見による良好な予後についても考察する。
